# Third-party notices

<!-- Generated by scripts/release/third_party_notices.sh from packaging/about/. Do not edit by hand. -->

The `ticoraw` command-line tool and the `ticoraw` and `ticoraw-dng` crates are licensed
under MIT OR Apache-2.0 (see `LICENSE-MIT` and `LICENSE-APACHE`). Built with their default
features, they contain the Rust crates listed below, each under its own licence. Test,
benchmark and build-time dependencies are not part of the built software and are not
listed.

## Independent JPEG Group

This software is based in part on the work of the Independent JPEG Group.

The JPEG encoder used for DNG previews contains code derived from the Independent JPEG
Group's software; its licence text, with the copyright notices, is reproduced below.
